title: Clue glue words
blurb: Words and phrases that help cryptic clues read smoothly. They are not wordplay indicators — though some ambiguous entries can occasionally double as weak signals.

categories.title: Definition linkers
categories.blurb: Words and phrases that join the definition to the wordplay without signaling an operation — e.g. is, means, becomes.

categories.title: Neutral glue
categories.blurb: Articles, prepositions, relatives, conjunctions, and common frames that usually make a clue read smoothly rather than indicate wordplay.

categories.title: Ambiguous softeners
categories.blurb: Hedge words often used as filler but sometimes weak indicators (perhaps, maybe, reportedly). Context decides.
